summary: States that ansible-core X.Y.Z releases come from stable-X.Y branches, which are cut from devel near X.Y.0 beta 1, and only bugfixes (backported from devel) go into them.
questions: Which branch are ansible-core point releases built from?
Can new features be added to a stable ansible-core branch?

answer_card.title: ansible-core stable branches
answer_card.answer_md: Every `X.Y.Z` release is built from `stable-X.Y`, cut from `devel` around `X.Y.0 beta 1`. Only **bugfixes** (no enhancements) go in, made against `devel` first and then backported.
